bio:
atlantic w/ saparilla

*Bi-monthly* 

saparilla is a DJ, producer, organiser & child of the water, born & raised in South London but forging themselves in Glasgow.

Toeing the line of cultural sociology & having fun, saparilla plays music from across Atlantic culture (a term they've adopted from sociologist Paul Gilroy). Using found audio from the internet & pulling from Caribbean sound-system culture, they conjure genre-fluid mixes with a bass-heavy & percussive sound that are somewhat sociological, to evoke tonic whines & draw cultural links in a way that is identifiably saparillic.
title: saparilla
